panels.title: Proxy HTTP requests by status
panels.description: Total request count served by the Kotlin proxy (cumulative counter; resets on deploy/restart).

panels.title: Retrieval HTTP requests by status
panels.description: Total request count served by the retrieval-server (cumulative counter; resets on deploy/restart).

panels.title: Proxy HTTP latency
panels.description: Request latency percentiles for the Kotlin proxy.

panels.title: Retrieval HTTP latency
panels.description: Request latency percentiles for the retrieval-server.

panels.title: Proxy CPU utilization (%)
panels.description: Busy CPU as % of all cores: 100 minus the average per-core idle rate (fly_instance_cpu is a per-core centiseconds counter).

panels.title: Retrieval CPU utilization (%)
panels.description: Busy CPU as % of all cores: 100 minus the average per-core idle rate (fly_instance_cpu is a per-core centiseconds counter).

panels.title: LLM requests/h by vendor
panels.description: Request count per hour — increase(llm_request_total[1h]), readable at low traffic volumes.

targets.expr: sum by (vendor) (rate(llm_request_total{app=~".*-development",status="error", vendor=~"$vendor", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (vendor) (rate(llm_request_total{app=~".*-development", vendor=~"$vendor", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, vendor) (rate(llm_request_duration_seconds_bucket{app=~".*-development", vendor=~"$vendor", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Cost (USD)
panels.description: Total LLM spend over the selected dashboard time range, overall and per vendor.

targets.expr: sum by (vendor, model) (rate(llm_tokens_total{app=~".*-development", direction="input", vendor=~"$vendor", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (vendor, model) (rate(llm_tokens_total{app=~".*-development", direction="output", vendor=~"$vendor", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (vendor, model) (rate(llm_tokens_total{app=~".*-development", direction=~"cache_read|cache_creation", vendor=~"$vendor", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Requests/h — $model
panels.description: Hourly LLM API calls for this model, split by vendor and status.
